note: Declared LLM call sites. Registered into LightTrack via `lt use-cases register`; the gap between this declaration and observed events.name is the coverage report.

use_cases.name: Generate ranked list items from a topic
use_cases.description: Generates the ranked list of items (title, description, metadata) for a studio-created topic.

use_cases.name: Resolve the correct Wikipedia article title for an item
use_cases.description: Uses Gemini with Google Search to identify the exact Wikipedia article title for a given item title, as a step toward finding its image.

use_cases.name: Find a direct image URL for an item from trusted sources
use_cases.description: Uses Gemini with Google Search to locate a direct, high-quality image URL for an item from a whitelist of trusted sources when Wikipedia lookups fail.

use_cases.name: Find the official YouTube video for a music item
use_cases.description: Uses Gemini with Google Search to find and return the official YouTube URL for a given song or music item.

use_cases.name: Generate a design description for a shareable result image
use_cases.description: Calls Gemini via raw REST to produce a detailed design description for a ranking's shareable social-media result image, based on computed layout/composition data.

use_cases.name: Recommend metadata for a ranking item
use_cases.description: Uses Gemini with Google Search to recommend year, image URL, description, and reference URL metadata for an item added to a ranking.

use_cases.name: Generate a contrarian debate challenge for a tier placement
use_cases.description: Generates an AI debate argument challenging or validating a user's tier placement of an item, with supporting facts and a controversy score.

use_cases.name: Generate AI artwork for a ranking's shareable image
use_cases.description: Generates AI artwork illustrating a ranking for sharing, via OpenAI DALL-E 3 or Replicate Stable Diffusion XL depending on selected provider, with a mock fallback.
